text: As required by the City's Investment Policy, the purpose of this report is to provide the Toronto Investment Board with the following: 1. The performance of the Sinking Fund and Long Term Fund for the fourth quarter and full year 2022. 2. Investment Policy and Plan Compliance certificates and reports for the fourth quarter of 2022.
The Toronto Investment Board received the report (February 21, 2023) from the Director, Capital Markets.
